brief:
# Workers + API accounts + routing rules (Brett)

## Problem
`node deploy/claude-workers.mjs status` shows no account as worker (cfg.workers empty), so the orchestrator only runs builds on the interactive account. account-3 (hulu0241@gmail.com) sits idle. Also the script says API-key accounts are never workers.

## Do
1. All subscription logins are workers: account-1 (brettspend), account-3 (hulu0241, 'Hulu'), mossesx-max- (Moses X). The interactive/active account can also take headless jobs (setting, default on). Fix whatever left cfg.workers empty and make sure the orchestrator actually routes across all workers in parallel (per-account queue max default 5, building default 3).
2. Allow API-key accounts as workers: add 'Hulu API' and 'Moses X API' slots (keys from the vault; never print or commit keys). API accounts are billed per token, so they only get jobs that match routing rules.
3. Orchestrator settings interface: rules for which jobs go to API accounts vs subscription accounts. Rules on job type, model, size/estimated steps, priority, profile, when subscriptions are limited/busy (fallback), and daily/weekly spend caps per API account with alerts. Rule order, enable/disable, test-a-job preview showing which account it would go to.
4. Show per-account status in the console: role, running, limit, cost today/week.

## Rules
- Settings in categorized collapsible sections; registry assets; full voice + API/MCP/CLI parity.
- Submit 3 UI options to UI Review.
- Tests for routing rules and spend caps. Report, STATUS, THREADS as usual.

open: No API keys on the VPS for the two slots. The axHub vault holds only the console token, the GitHub token and the SSH key, and the AI keys keyring is empty, so nothing could be copied in. Each slot shows "No key" with a banner item. To fill one: Terminal → VPS host → `claude-account savekey hulu-api` (then `mossesx-api`), and paste the key at the hidden prompt.
`account-5` is an older API-key account (owner unknown). It is listed as "API · not used" and takes no jobs.
No routing rules yet, so the API slots take nothing until Brett adds one (or turns on an overflow rule).
A cap is checked when a job starts; a job that is already running finishes even if it crosses the cap.
Claude setting `builds.maxParallel` (1, owner raises) still limits how many builds a Claude session starts by itself; the agent cap (6 VPS-wide) still applies on top of the per-account limits.
